question: What has the U.S. government done abroad with sanctions and money since 2025?
answer: The world record holds 12 U.S. government actions since 2025 that changed money abroad, February 26, 2025 to June 1, 2026: sanctions and takedowns aimed at Russia's crypto routes and Venezuela's oil, a Section 301 trade case against Brazil's Pix payment system, a $20 billion Treasury swap line for Argentina, a tariff deal with Indonesia, a U.S.-UK markets taskforce and the G20 boycott. 5 rest on a U.S. government document; the other 7 link news or law-firm pages and are marked 'needs primary source'.

items.title: Project Pine — the New York Fed and the BIS Innovation Hub, with the ECB, Bank of England and four others — proves central banks can run monetary policy in a fully tokenized system …
items.text: Project Pine — the New York Fed and the BIS Innovation Hub, with the ECB, Bank of England and four others — proves central banks can run monetary policy in a fully tokenized system: interest on reserves, asset purchases, collateral calls, all by smart contract. The central banks aren't fighting the ledger; they're learning to drive it.
